lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A regular matrix of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately 12 discernible vertical columns between the branchial region and the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal carinae to form a grid-like pattern, with circular spots localized at the intersections of these axes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary longitudinal ridges are visible on the lateral flank, defined by a sharp intensity transition from light (dorsal edge) to dark (ventral edge) running parallel to the main body axis.

other_distinctive_markers: A cluster of approximately 7 high-contrast linear silhouettes (remoras) is visible along the ventral-lateral margin, oriented parallel to the shark's longitudinal axis.
